purpose: Standing ledger of strategic bets — the compounding-strategy layer on top of the mechanical gates (cooldown/track_record/clone/lead_prescreen). hypotheses.statement: CONSUMPTION and LAUNCH-DAY are different effects and they point opposite ways. Consumption (channel impressions by weekday, de-trended vs trailing-7d mean, n=67 days): Mon 129% > Wed 115% > Tue 114% > Thu 106% > Fri 99% > Sun 110% > Sat 90% — the audience watches most Mon-Wed, which is where the banked 'Mondays always spike / place the rested hero on Monday PM' rule came from. But that measures CATALOG consumption. LAUNCH day, measured on true window-free impressions/day at age 4-12d, de-trended against each month's own median (n=110 ships): Fri 199% > Sat 128% > Thu 112% > Tue 106% > Mon 85% > Wed 77% > Sun 61%. Mon-Wed median 89% vs Thu-Fri median 163%. Not outlier-driven (10/16 Fri ships beat their month median vs 6/14 Mon ships). Not a measurement-window artifact either (the age-4-12d window overlaps the Mon-Wed consumption peak slightly more for Fri launches, but that accounts for ~4%, not a 2.3x gap). MECHANISM (untested): Monday's larger viewer pool is soaked up by the catalog giants, so a fresh ship competes hardest for share on exactly the day the pool is biggest — consistent with the banked 'one viewer pool per day; extra ships split it' finding. Friday's pool is smaller but the catalog is quieter, so a new ship takes a larger share of it.
hypotheses.predicted_metric: A ship launched Thu/Fri should post >=1.5x the age-4-12d true impressions/day of a comparable-strength cell launched Mon/Wed in the same month. Falsified if Mon/Wed ships match or beat Thu/Fri over the next ~6 ships.

hypotheses.source: chat_2026-07-26 — user asked 'any possibility that thumbnail also leads to more impressions?' during Test #50 launch
hypotheses.statement: A thumbnail refresh on a still-ALIVE decaying video can expand impressions (flatten the decay slope), not just convert better. Mechanism: impressions are downstream of predicted performance (expected CTR x expected watch-time); a thumb that lifts real CTR while AVD holds raises the serving score and widens sampling. This is DISTINCT from the banked dead-video finding (Test #43 Brain Detox: CTR +0.7pp, impressions kept falling — no re-expansion once a video is churned). Conditions for the effect: (1) video still in active rotation (Morning Energy = ~27K impr/day at launch), (2) CTR crosses above the alive-morning peer band (~4.3-5.6; baseline 4.4 rising), (3) AVD holds within ~2pp (energy-promise vs calm Yaman music is the risk). If confirmed, re-thumb targeting shifts from 'weak-CTR dead videos' (worthless) to 'fatigued-thumb ALIVE videos' (the 3hr Bansuri + this).
hypotheses.predicted_metric: Test #50 vehicle (Morning Energy Dilruba, DMcoOLvmAyQ, launched 2026-07-26; pre-test slope 53K->27K impr/day, -38% w/w). CONFIRMED if challenger (BOOST YOUR ENERGY) wins/co-leads watch-time share AND w/w impressions slope flattens to better than ~-20% at the 14d read AND AVD within 2pp of ~22 baseline. KILLED-for-alive-videos if challenger wins share but slope stays <=-30% w/w (would extend Test-43's 'conversion not distribution' rule to alive videos). VOID if control wins (no packaging delta applied). Ignore any 3-5 day novelty re-test bump — judge at 14d only.

hypotheses.statement: At this channel's current scale, REACH is set by the instrument x lane x runtime CELL, not by packaging. Evidence: 40+ title/thumb-text A/Bs and now 2 image A/Bs have all failed to move fresh-ship CTR off ~2.5-3.4%, and every ship for 5 straight weeks has landed 0.24-0.66x the age-matched median regardless of lane, instrument, title or thumb. Meanwhile ONE cell separates cleanly: Bansuri x sleep x 3hr posts a median 9,868 engaged views against 592 for the other 13 3hr ships — 16.7x — and the 3 Bansuri figures are trailing-28d residual on videos 52-106 days old, so the gap is understated.
